content: {"like":["Values strong, realistic protagonists in action‑fantasy series like Dragon Hunters.","Prefers original, high‑quality animation and storytelling over sequels, e.g., The Fox and the Hound 2.","Enjoys well‑voiced character performances in animated sequels, such as The Jungle Book 2.","Appreciates thematic depth and character development in sci‑fi horror, e.g., Prometheus.","Likes complex, slow‑paced narratives with plot twists in sci‑fi sequels, e.g., Alien: Covenant."],"dislike":["Dislikes poorly drawn animation and irritating characters in TV adaptations, e.g., Dragon Hunters 2.","Finds sequels lacking originality and emotional depth, e.g., The Fox and the Hound 2.","Rejects repetitive musical motifs and missing key characters in animated sequels, e.g., The Jungle Book 2.","Criticizes thin, unoriginal storytelling and excessive technical detail in sci‑fi horror, e.g., Alien Resurrection.","Dislikes slow pacing and tragic villain victories in sci‑fi sequels, e.g., Alien: Covenant."]}
